remarks: New construction opportunity! A beautiful, Mark Dean designed two-story home is planned for this property, offering ~1,500 square feet of living space, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, first floor laundry, and attached 2 car garage. The seller will complete construction, providing buyers the opportunity to own a brand-new home without taking on the building process themselves. Get it under contract today and pick your siding, colors, and cosmetic finishes. Listing photos will be updated as construction progresses, showcasing the home's transformation from start to finish. Don't miss the opportunity to make this newly built home your own in the Lower West Side of Buffalo neighborhood. Target for completion and new certificate of occupancy is Valentines Day next year, foundation will be poured the week of October 19th!
